headline: Banco ABC Brasil signs agreement to acquire stake in Angá Asset for up to R$690 million
summary: Banco ABC Brasil signed a share purchase agreement to acquire a stake in Angá Controle Holding, which consolidates Angá Asset Management. The transaction value could reach up to R$690 million.
why: Banco ABC Brasil is a commercial bank expanding its asset management capabilities in Brazil, where Angá oversees approximately R$24 billion in assets under management.
